items.name: parse_percent
items.source:
pub fn parse_percent(value: &str) -> Result<u8, String> {
    value
        .trim()
        .trim_end_matches('%')
        .parse::<u8>()
        .ok()
        .filter(|percent| (1..=100).contains(percent))
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("expected a percentage from 1 to 100, got '{value}'"))
}
